verdict.rationale: Twenty documents both REST and GraphQL APIs that adapt to custom objects, with auto-generated per-workspace documentation and an interactive playground for live calls. The API also covers schema changes through a Metadata API, role-scoped API keys, and batch operations, and a hands-on community user reports the REST API "worked ok." Missing for 10: a publicly reachable static OpenAPI spec (the probe found none, since docs are generated per workspace), and stronger independent corroboration beyond one lukewarm hands-on report.
